### ABOUT US
### Redefining the future of human-machine collaboration 

OMRON Robotics empowers businesses with advanced technology and tailored solutions to solve complex
manufacturing challenges, optimize processes, and work smarter. By automating repetitive tasks and
enabling seamless collaboration, our robots’ free teams to focus on critical, creative, and
strategic work. Together with our customers, we are shaping a future where humans and robots work
side-by-side, advancing industries, driving innovation, and fostering the well-being of our global
society.

### About Us

RoboCup is an international scientific initiative with the goal to advance the state of the art of
intelligent robots. When established in 1997, the original mission was to field a team of robots
capable of winning against the human soccer World Cup champions by 2050.

### About Us

RoboCup is an international scientific initiative with the goal to advance the state of the art of
intelligent robots. When established in 1997, the original mission was to field a team of robots
capable of winning against the human soccer World Cup champions by 2050.

## Robotnik

Robotnik designs, manufactures and markets mobile robots and mobile manipulators.

Our company was founded in 2002 and **we are currently a reference company in mobile robotics
worldwide and leaders in Europe.**

[MORE INFORMATION][58]

### Our Services

Robotnik is specialized in the development of industrial robotic applications based in mobile
platforms and mobile manipulators.

Collaborative robots handle repetitive and ergonomically challenging tasks with precision and

## Red Cat Closes Acquisition of Apium Swarm Robotics

[Red Cat Holdings, Inc.][13], announced it has acquired Apium Swarm Robotics, a California-based
developer of distributed control systems for autonomous swarming drones and uncrewed surface vessels
(USVs). Apium will operate as an independent Red Cat company, continuing to develop and scale its
multi-agent autonomy architecture for integration across Red Cat’s Family of Systems. The
acquisition deepens Red Cat’s ability to deliver intelligent, adaptive unmanned systems that enable
coordinated operations in contested and communication-degraded environments.

[ Read More ][14]

## Apium Joins Red Cat Futures Initiative to Advance Swarming Autonomy for Tactical Drones

[Apium][15] Swarm Robotics, Inc. a developer of distributed autonomy for unmanned systems, has
signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with[ Red Cat Holdings, Inc.][16] (Nasdaq: RCAT). Through
this agreement, Apium joins the[ Red Cat Futures Initiative][17], an industry-wide robotics and
autonomous systems (RAS) consortium dedicated to putting the most advanced and interoperable
uncrewed aircraft systems into the hands of warfighters.

[ Read More ][18]
[ View More Updates ][19]

## DEFINING THE FUTURE OF ALL DOMAIN OPERATIONS

Red Cat is an end-to-end drone solutions company based in the United States that is accelerating the
future of aerial robotics to transform the way we live and work. We have a disciplined acquisition
strategy that targets companies with advanced product offerings and specialized drone operational
platforms and intellectual property to provide comprehensive solutions for our customers and value
for our shareholders.

Our small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) technology is grounded in real-world impact providing
critical actionable intelligence and enabling operator safety for the defense, security, industrial,
and space markets.

## JEFF
## THOMPSON

CEO
RED CAT

Thompson is a serial tech entrepreneur who has led companies from the startup phase to successful
exits and IPOs. Founder of EdgeNet, a private ISP, and co-founder of Towerstream, a wireless service
provider (public 2007 NASDAQ). In 2018 he founded Red Cat, the company at the forefront of providing
solutions for the rapidly growing commercial and recreational drone industries.

## Chris
## Ericson

COO
RED CAT

Chris Ericson has extensive finance, accounting and public company reporting experience. Prior to
his appointment as Red Cat’s Chief Operating Officer, Mr. Ericson served as the Company’s Chief
Financial Officer since March 2025. Previously, Mr. Ericson was the Head of Finance and Accounting
at Western Steel Buildings, where he played a pivotal role in scaling financial operations and
optimizing compliance and governance structures to support rapid business growth. Mr. Ericson’s
experience also includes 11 years with PricewaterhouseCoopers, and senior finance roles at Nu Skin
Enterprises, where he served as Chief Audit Executive, VP of Business Development, and VP of Finance
for its agriculture technology division. Mr. Ericson is a Certified Public Accountant and has a
Master of Accountancy degree and Bachelor of Science in Accountancy degree from Brigham Young
University.

## Josh
## Ziska

President
APIUM

Josh Ziska is a founder and veteran focused on developing practical, high-impact technology in
autonomy, security, and critical infrastructure protection. He serves as the President of Apium
Swarm Robotics, where he applies a background in unmanned systems that began in the U.S. Navy.
There, he built a foundation in operational planning, mission execution, and the real-world
application of emerging technologies—experience that continues to shape his approach to building and
deploying technology today.


He works at the intersection of strategy, product development, and execution, with a focus on
solving urgent operational problems and delivering measurable value. Josh has led efforts across
unmanned systems and defense-adjacent technologies, shaping products through direct operational
experience. Drawing from time spent as an end user in real-world environments, he brings a grounded
perspective to product development—prioritizing usability, reliability, and mission effectiveness.

At Apium Swarm Robotics, he is focused on advancing one-to-many autonomy through software that
enables a single user to manage and deploy distributed unmanned systems, reduce cognitive burden
while increasing the scale and effectiveness of autonomous operations across defense and commercial
environments.

# We're on a mission
# to enable the future
# of marine robotics


[ Explore BlueROV2 ][277] [ Explore Components ][278]

### Game-Changing Cost

Our constant focus on cost and accessibility make our thrusters, components, USV, and underwater ROV
the most affordable on the market.

### Flexible & Expandable

Straightforward designs with open source software and hardware allow for customization,

intel.summary:
# Training Data for Physical AI

Purpose-built datasets for frontier robotics, embodied AI, and world models.

## Millions of clips. Every environment.

Egocentric video, game environments, driving, cinematic, manufacturing, cooking, warehouse, and
human activity data -- curated for frontier AI labs training world models, VLAs, and video
generation systems.

## More than video. Captured, enriched, annotated, and delivered to your pipeline.

Every clip ships with depth maps, pose estimation, segmentation masks, and structured metadata.
Licensed, real-world video -- not synthetic, not scraped. Expert humans label what machines miss:
intent, context, edge cases. Your format. Your pipeline. Ready to train.

## 10,000+ collectors. 100+ cities. Every environment your model needs.

A global network of trained data collectors capturing real-world video across 6 continents. Suburban
kitchens. Factory floors. City streets. Not lab data -- real-world data at scale.

## Built for frontier labs. Proven at scale.

500K+ egocentric videos captured for a world-modeling lab. 10K+ hours of game environment data. 2M+
video annotations powering RLHF for frontier video generation.

4M+ human annotations. 100+ active datasets. 10,000+ collectors worldwide. 5+ frontier lab
partnerships.

## Tell us what you are training.

From brief to first delivery in days, not months. We scope the dataset, design the pipeline, and
deliver training-ready data on your timeline.

[Book a Call][1][[email protected]][2]

## Global Supplier of Advanced Robotics Technology

As one of the world’s largest automotive parts manufacturers, DENSO has been a leader and pioneer in
manufacturing automation, including the design and manufacturing of industrial robot arms, since the
1960s. DENSO is also the world’s largest user of small assembly robots, from 4-axis SCARA robots to
5- and 6-axis [articulated robots.][58]

More than 27,000 DENSO small industrial robots are employed in the company’s own manufacturing
facilities, and more than 143,000 additional DENSO small industrial robots are used by other
companies worldwide.

## Разделы для IT-специалистов

[Все разделы →][27]
[

## Frontend разработчику

Современные JavaScript фреймворки (React, Vue, Angular), CSS библиотеки, инструменты сборки, UI
компоненты, анимации, прогрессивные веб-приложения. Новинки для создания интерактивных
пользовательских интерфейсов.

][28] [

## Backend разработчику

Серверные фреймворки (Node.js, Python, Java, Go, PHP). REST и GraphQL API, микросервисы, базы
данных, кеширование, очереди сообщений. Инструменты для разработки надежного серверного кода.

][29] [

## Mobile разработчику

React Native, Flutter, Swift для iOS, Kotlin для Android. Кроссплатформенные решения, нативные
библиотеки, UI/UX компоненты для мобильных приложений.

][30] [

## DevOps инженеру

Контейнеризация (Docker, Podman), оркестрация (Kubernetes), CI/CD пайплайны, Infrastructure as Code
(Terraform, Ansible), мониторинг, логирование, облачные платформы.

][31] [

## AI/ML инженеру

Фреймворки машинного обучения (TensorFlow, PyTorch), обработка данных, нейронные сети, компьютерное
зрение, NLP, MLOps. Новые модели и инструменты для искусственного интеллекта.

][32] [

## GameDev разработчику

Игровые движки (Unity, Unreal Engine), 2D/3D графика, игровая физика, инструменты создания игр,
ассеты, шейдеры. Ресурсы для разработки видеоигр.

][33] [

## Blockchain разработчику

Смарт-контракты (Solidity, Rust), DeFi протоколы, Web3 библиотеки, криптовалютные инструменты, NFT,
децентрализованные приложения (dApps).

][34] [

## Embedded разработчику

Микроконтроллеры (Arduino, Raspberry Pi), IoT решения, драйверы, RTOS, протоколы связи, аппаратное
взаимодействие. Инструменты для встраиваемых систем.

][35] [

## Cybersecurity специалисту

Инструменты пентестинга, анализ уязвимостей, криптография, сетевая безопасность, форензика, анализ
вредоносного ПО. Решения для защиты информационных систем.

][36] [

## QA инженеру

Фреймворки автоматизации тестирования (Selenium, Cypress, Jest), нагрузочное тестирование, API
тестирование, мобильное тестирование. Инструменты обеспечения качества.

][37] [

## Data Scientist

Библиотеки анализа данных (pandas, numpy), визуализация (matplotlib, D3.js), статистика, Jupyter
notebooks, big data инструменты. Ресурсы для работы с данными.

][38] [

## Data Engineer

ETL/ELT пайплайны, Apache Spark, Airflow, базы данных (SQL/NoSQL), потоковая обработка данных,
дата-озера. Инструменты для инженерии данных.

][39] [

## Дизайнеру

Design системы, прототипирование, инструменты UI/UX, анимации, иконки, цветовые палитры,
типографика. Ресурсы для веб и графического дизайна.

][40] [

## Productivity & Tools

Редакторы кода, плагины IDE, утилиты разработчика, инструменты командной работы, автоматизация
рутинных задач. Программы для повышения продуктивности.

][41] [

## CLI Tools

Консольные утилиты, системное администрирование, скрипты автоматизации, терминальные интерфейсы.
Инструменты командной строки для разработчиков.

][42] [

## Open Source

Значимые комьюнити проекты, стартапы с открытым кодом, инструменты для поддержки open source.
Популярные проекты с открытым исходным кодом.

* **Raspberry Pi** main computer
* **Great agility and maneuverability**

* **Simulator-ready** for testing visual algorithms
* **Onboard AI** and computer vision capabilities

## NDAA Compliance

compliance. All of our UAV platforms are **fully capable of meeting NDAA compliance**, ensuring that
our products are free from components sourced from prohibited manufacturers as outlined in Section
889 of the U.S. National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), including Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision,
and Dahua.

We rely on trusted and verified supply chains for all critical components, guaranteeing that our
UAVs meet U.S. government standards for secure operations. This makes our UAVs ideal **for
applications** **where NDAA compliance is required or preferred**. Our commitment to NDAA compliance
underscores our dedication to providing safe, reliable, and trusted technology to our customers

## collaborative robot programming, simulation and control software

**operators and robots
**work better together

**decode** combines operators’ **expert knowledge** and decision-making with the **speed, precision,
and efficiency** of robots.
* **empowers operators** **to be more productive** by applying their intelligence and expertise
  where and when it’s needed whilst **delegating the dull, dirty, and dangerous **parts of any
  process to a robot
* enables the automation of **previously impossible tasks** through the **instant reprogramming of
  robots**
* unlocks **economies of scale for the manufacture of small batches** by allowing robots to adapt to
  change **without production interruption**
[Collaborative Robot, human-robot collaboration, yaskawa robot programming]

## deploy your collaborative robot application in minutes

**decode **enables** users with no robotics or programming expertise** to **flexibly automate new
and variable tasks**, that would require days of specialist work using conventional offline robot
programming (OLRP) software or leadthrough teaching

It can be used to program ABB robots and cobots, Doosan cobots, Fanuc robots and cobots, Inovo

cobots, UFactory xArm cobots, Universal Robots cobots, and Yaskawa robots and cobots.

yet, please [**contact us**][39].

## The HAL Robotics Framework: a no-code programming and robot simulation software platform

### The HAL Robotics Framework

Underpinning **decode** and our services is the [HAL Robotics Framework][90], an extensible and
modular software which facilitates **adaptive programming of robot tasks**, inter-device
communication, and motion planning for one or many robots working together.

The Framework covers an **end-to-end workflow** from cell modelling right through to robot execution
and deployment.

## MODEL

Create complete digital twins of your cells with robots, tools & controllers

## PROGRAM

Generate robot tasks automatically from user input or CAD data

## SIMULATE

Visualise your programs and diagnose feasibility, collisions and cycle time

## TRANSLATE

Create machine code compatible with your robot controller

## CONNECT

Establish communications between your robots and devices

## MONITOR

Log and analyze execution events to prevent failures and improve production

## DEPLOY

Distribute your application to workstations, embedded systems or the cloud

[TECHNOLOGY][91]

## A UNIFIED, ROBUST ROBOTICS SOFTWARE PLATFORM FOR TRAINING, RESEARCH AND INDUSTRIALIsATION

With our highly flexible robot simulation and programming software and SDK, HAL Robotics **helps
academic and corporate research push the boundaries of robotics** in the UK, Europe, North America,
Asia, and Australia.

# HTL Electronics.

*Distribuidores oficiales de MiR y Universal Robots México.*

[ Contáctanos ][54]

## Entrenamiento en Universal Robots, MiR, Robotiq, Mech Mind y Wago

HTL Training Center es el primer Centro de Capacitación autorizado en Latinoamérica de un
Distribuidor (HTL Electronics) para impartir los más novedosos cursos de certificación de Universal
Robots A/S. Certifícate en compañía de los ingenieros más enfocado en la Industria Colaborativa de
México.

## Desarrollos Certificados

La plataforma Universal Robots+ se ha diseñado para facilitar la integración de los componentes y
extender el concepto de facilidad de uso e instalación. Este principio no se aplica sólo al propio
robot, sino también a todos los elementos que forman la aplicación.

### Desde 2009 ofrecemos soluciones, brindando el mejor servicio y soporte a nuestros clientes.

## Partners

## Servicios

### Training Center

Impartición de los nuevos primeros cursos de certificación de Universal Robots A/S Certifícate con
nuestro equipo de ingenieros enfocados en la Industria Colaborativa de México. Ofrecemos todo tipo
de cursos y entrenamientos en automatización, desde disciplinas básicas hasta avanzadas.

[ Ver Más ][55]

### Simulations

Nuestro servicio de simulación de procesos robóticos utiliza la plataforma líder, RoboDK, para
ofrecer análisis precisos de factibilidad. Por ello, antes de realizar una inversión importante en
equipos, permítenos mostrarte una representación virtual detallada de cómo operará el robot en tu
entorno de producción.

[ Ver Más ][56]

### HTL Expert Services

Ofrecemos servicio de programación y puesta en marcha para cobots UR y MiR; así como soporte en
línea o en planta para solución de problemas, y evaluación de equipo y performance. También
generamos una póliza anual de servicio y mantenimiento para cobots UR y AMR MiR

[ Ver Más ][57]
Años de experiencia

## Estrategas Capacitados

Sabemos que cada cliente requiere un estratega para la correcta implementación de cobots; por ello,
nuestros ingenieros ofrecen las herramientas correctas para la manipulación de objetos, cálculo de
tiempos de ciclo, análisis de seguridad acorde a las normas de la Industria Colaborativa y
capacitación.

InDro Commander integration. This also includes quadrupeds (legged robots) from Unitree Robotics and
our InDro Backpack integration. In the air, we can distribute UAVs from many manufacturers and/or
integrate our InDro Pilot technology to enable real-time data transfer (over 5G) for BVLOS missions
and onboard processing for autonomous missions.

##### Are your robots autonomous?

Our robots can be autonomous with the right integrations. For unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), our
InDro Commander technology enables the robot to have local compute, be teleoperations-enabled and/or
autonomy-ready. After these hardware integrations, InDro Robotics can provide documentation and

of our own autonomy software for commercial applications. The same is applicable to our drones with
our InDro Pilot technology. For the quadrupeds, they come pre-equipped with the hardware required to
enable development of a SLAM-based autonomy, but can be outfitted with the InDro Backpack to enable
teleoperations and GPS-based autonomy.

##### How do you work with research & development entities?

The InDro Robotics sales team is well equipped to discuss the technical requirements of a given
research and development project and identify the optimal platform and integrations specific to the
use case or application. Our team is capable of working within your budget in accordance with your
funding requirements and timeline. InDro Robotics will also collaborate with academia, industry and
governments on joint-projects.

##### How many versions of the Commander are there?

There are 3 standard versions of the InDro Commander, but it can always be customized to meet
specific requirements or leverage existing hardware owned by the client. The standard versions
include the InDro Commander Standard (local compute-ready), InDro Commander Connect (4G/5G
teleoperations-ready) and InDro Commander Navigate (GPS & SLAM autonomy-ready).

##### How do I know which platform is best for my application?

The InDro Robotics sales team leverages experience from past clients and real-world deployments to
recommend the optimal platform based on a variety of factors like: form factor, steering type,
battery life, payload capacity, suspension, IP rating, tire/tread type, speed and more.

##### Why buy from a distributor instead of the manufacturer directly?

When purchasing from a distributor you end up paying less, experience lower lead times and get local
support on the products you purchase. If the product originates overseas, the manufacturer will
offer DAP shipping terms, so you will pay for importation and assume liability for the products
being shipped to you. Often times, this means you deal with the headache of tracking the package,
answering questions from your procurement department and it complicates budgeting as you end up
paying more than quoted. Additionally, all integrations available through InDro Robotics that are
typically required to outfit your robot for the application are not available through the
manufacturer.

##### Why purchase an InDro Kit (Commander, Backpack, Pilot) instead of doing the integrations
##### ourselves?

Time. Robotics is challenging enough without needing to tinker with and troubleshoot the hardware;
the InDro Kits come fully integrated with ROS/ROS2 and documentation to jump-start any research
project. Compared to traditional “kits”, ours can be customized to only include the hardware
(compute, cameras, sensors, etc.) that you don’t already have available to you as it can be shipped
to us for integration or we can support your own integration remotely. Either way, your hardware
will be protected in our sealed box and metal work while remaining accessible for expansion.

## frequently asked questions

##### Do you manufacture your robots and drones?

InDro Robotics serves as a manufacturer, integrator and distributor of unmanned systems. Right now
on the ground, these systems include unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) from AgileX Robotics with our
InDro Commander integration. This also includes quadrupeds (legged robots) from Unitree Robotics and
our InDro Backpack integration. In the air, we can distribute UAVs from many manufacturers and/or
integrate our InDro Pilot technology to enable real-time data transfer (over 5G) for BVLOS missions
and onboard processing for autonomous missions.

##### Are your robots autonomous?

Our robots can be autonomous with the right integrations. For unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), our
InDro Commander technology enables the robot to have local compute, be teleoperations-enabled and/or
autonomy-ready. After these hardware integrations, InDro Robotics can provide documentation and
assistance to support your own development of autonomy software or provide a user-friendly version
of our own autonomy software for commercial applications. The same is applicable to our drones with
our InDro Pilot technology. For the quadrupeds, they come pre-equipped with the hardware required to
enable development of a SLAM-based autonomy, but can be outfitted with the InDro Backpack to enable
teleoperations and GPS-based autonomy.

##### How do you work with research & development entities?

The InDro Robotics sales team is well equipped to discuss the technical requirements of a given
research and development project and identify the optimal platform and integrations specific to the
use case or application. Our team is capable of working within your budget in accordance with your
funding requirements and timeline. InDro Robotics will also collaborate with academia, industry and
governments on joint-projects.

##### How many versions of the Commander are there?

There are 3 standard versions of the InDro Commander, but it can always be customized to meet
specific requirements or leverage existing hardware owned by the client. The standard versions
include the InDro Commander Standard (local compute-ready), InDro Commander Connect (4G/5G
teleoperations-ready) and InDro Commander Navigate (GPS & SLAM autonomy-ready).

##### How do I know which platform is best for my application?

The InDro Robotics sales team leverages experience from past clients and real-world deployments to
recommend the optimal platform based on a variety of factors like: form factor, steering type,
battery life, payload capacity, suspension, IP rating, tire/tread type, speed and more.

##### Why buy from a distributor instead of the manufacturer directly?

When purchasing from a distributor you end up paying less, experience lower lead times and get local
support on the products you purchase. If the product originates overseas, the manufacturer will
offer DAP shipping terms, so you will pay for importation and assume liability for the products
being shipped to you. Often times, this means you deal with the headache of tracking the package,
answering questions from your procurement department and it complicates budgeting as you end up
paying more than quoted. Additionally, all integrations available through InDro Robotics that are
typically required to outfit your robot for the application are not available through the
manufacturer.

##### Why purchase an InDro Kit (Commander, Backpack, Pilot) instead of doing the integrations
##### ourselves?

Time. Robotics is challenging enough without needing to tinker with and troubleshoot the hardware;
the InDro Kits come fully integrated with ROS/ROS2 and documentation to jump-start any research
project. Compared to traditional “kits”, ours can be customized to only include the hardware
(compute, cameras, sensors, etc.) that you don’t already have available to you as it can be shipped
to us for integration or we can support your own integration remotely. Either way, your hardware
will be protected in our sealed box and metal work while remaining accessible for expansion.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

Automotive
From assembling small components to installing car electronics, JAKA cobots perform precise,
repetitive tasks with speed and accuracy. They help keep production consistent, reduce strain on
workers, and ensure high-quality results from start to finish.
Explore More
Electronics
Whether it's assembling tiny circuit boards, testing devices, or applying adhesives with millimetre
accuracy, JAKA cobots boost quality and speed. They protect sensitive components while keeping up
with fast production cycles.
Explore More
New Energy
Applied in battery cell assembly, testing, battery assembly, etc.
Explore More
Home Appliances
Widely used in home appliances, including palletizing, loading and unloading, sorting, screwdriving,
and other processes, helping companies significantly save labor and management costs.
Explore More
Food & Beverage
JAKA cobots automate packaging, labeling, palletizing, and material handling. They meet strict
hygiene standards while improving efficiency, reducing waste, and helping businesses adapt quickly
to changing demands.
Explore More
Metal Manufacturing

taking on repetitive, hazardous tasks, they reduce worker fatigue, improve workplace safety, and
ensure consistent results.

running smoothly even during peak times.

Experienced in ROS, KUKA robotics, and intelligent inspection systems.

# About me

Hello! I’m Al Mahdi Sallam, a Mechatronics and Robotics Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

I am a passionate and dedicated engineering graduate from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM) with
hands-on experience in robotics, AI, and automation. Currently, I work as a **Robotics Specialist at
AMSY**, where I handle complex fabrication tasks by programming and optimizing KUKA robotic cells
with Autodesk PowerMill, developing precision toolpaths, and implementing quality control
procedures.

[Al Mahdi working with KUKA robot] [Al Mahdi overseeing KUKA robot operation]

Working with KUKA Robots at AMSY

My expertise includes robotic system design, AI-driven automation, and embedded systems. I am
particularly skilled in programming for industrial robots, developing autonomous navigation systems
using **ROS (Robot Operating System)**, and implementing machine learning models (like YOLOv5) for
real-world applications like surface defect detection.

I’ve built my practical skills through international internships, including:
* **Robotics and AI Intern** at the KMITL - CIRA Lab in Thailand, where I designed a 4-DOF robotic
  arm for manufacturing inspection.
* **Automation Engineer Intern** with Pi Technology & Engineering in Malaysia, where I programmed
  and configured KUKA, ABB, and NACHI robots.

My academic work includes a capstone project on an autonomous pick-and-place robot and a final-year
project focused on training a TurtleBot3 for autonomous navigation using Deep Q-Network (DQN)
reinforcement learning algorithms.

I am a professionally accredited Engineer with the **Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE)** and an
active member of the robotics community.

I’m always looking to connect and explore new career opportunities in the field of robotics and
automation. Please feel free to browse my projects and publications, or check out my CV for more
details.

# [MORE ADVENTURES IN LIFE][MORE ADVENTURES IN LIFE]

Compact, lightweight, and durable.
Rain or snow? Nothing to fear.
When something worthy of a photo catches your eye, simply press the shutter button.
What you feel in that moment is captured in the image.
Enjoy capturing the world exactly as you see it.
For people who chase exciting experiences.
For people who want to capture unique beautiful moments in a photograph.
OM SYSTEM is the perfect partner for your adventures.

[OM SYSTEM]

## [ADVENTURE]The OM SYSTEM Adventure

### Step outside with OM SYSTEM

The world is full of new discoveries—from an unexpected beautiful scene in the great outdoors, to an
unknown flower you find in a back alley of the city.

Outside, a whole world of vistas await. Heading out is the perfect way to experience how the seasons
change cities and landscapes.

Bring some wonder to your life by capturing your discoveries, amazing encounters, and inspiring
moments.

Unleash your spirit of adventure and enjoy the thrill of curiosity. The moment you step outside with
OM SYSTEM, your adventure begins.

## [PHOTOGRAPH]Photos That Inspire Adventure

### New experiences await you
### in each moment

Want to find an untouched corner of the natural world that hasn't been seen before? Want to capture
that once-in-a-lifetime moment in all it's beauty? OM SYSTEM offers nature lovers the perfect tools
to capture every image you imagine. The thrill of capturing something you've never photographed
before, will fuel your sense of adventure.

[View Images][8]

## [TECHNOLOGY]Technology For Capturing Adventure

[1][1]

### Technologies for perfectly capturing adventurous moments motivate you to go further

Never miss that precise moment. Capture something you've never photographed before. This is the
reason OM SYSTEM exists.

**A compact and lightweight system** that you can take anywhere.
Powerful **image stabilization** for hand-held shooting.
**Splash, dust and freezeproof construction** that stands up to the most punishing environments.
**Computational photography** enables creative and expressive photography.
**A unique lens lineup** exceeds every photographers expectations.

This system is the culmination of technology that is perfect for “MORE ADVENTURES IN LIFE.”
Welcome to OM SYSTEM.

### [OM Core Technology]
* [
  A compact and lightweight system

[2][2]

OM SYSTEM is carrying on the tradition of imaging products from its predecessor OLYMPUS. Our goal is
to provide cameras that can be taken along anywhere. The OLYMPUS OM-1 SLR 35mm film camera from
1972, revolutionized the global market with an authentic SLR system in a compact, lightweight
design. It delivered reliability and durability in punishing high-altitude and cold environments,
making it a beloved partner for many photographers and adventurers.

At OM SYSTEM, our passion and philosophy remains the same now as it was during the OLYMPUS era. As
represented by the OM SYSTEM OM-1 digital interchangeable lens camera, OM SYSTEM is committed to
providing a compact and lightweight camera system with superb image stabilization in a splash & dust
proof construction that is perfect for shooting in harsh environments outdoors. Thanks to superb
weather-resistant sealing you can feel at ease whenever you shoot outdoors or in a city; whilst
traveling or just capturing everyday scenes. OM SYSTEM is the perfect partner for your adventures,
delivering one-of-a-kind experiences in every outdoor situation.

## [EPILOGUE]To All OM SYSTEM Enthusiasts

### It's time to make some
### new discoveries

With OM SYSTEM,
you can go anywhere,
you can capture anything.

We offer a variety of cameras to suit your lifestyle.
Our range of lenses will satisfy your desire for creative expression.
However photography isn't the only way to enjoy an adventure.

With binoculars you can see details of the world, that the naked eye cannot.
With audio recorders you can capture sound with crystal clear fidelity.
With conveniently portable equipment and a curious mind you are sure to discover new vistas.

Enrich your life with OM SYSTEM products.

OM SYSTEM

  Expressive photography driven by the latest technologies is in your hands with the press of the

  ### Live ND
  
  Live ND is a feature that combines multiple images to simulate extended exposure times, achieving

* ## Computational photography
  
  Expressive photography driven by the latest technologies is in your hands with the press of the
  shutter button.
  
  ### Live GND
  
  Live GND enables you to beautifully capture scenes with high contrast between the sky and the
  ground, such as sunrises or sunsets. You can adjust the GND level, filter type, and position of
  the filter effect boundary directly through the viewfinder. The camera then composites multiple
  images, balancing highlights and shadows for a stunning final image.

  ISO 400, using Live GND
* ## Computational photography
  
  Expressive photography driven by the latest technologies is in your hands with the press of the
  shutter button.

  Live Composite Mode lets you shoot a series of images using the same exposure time, with each shot
  only recording new sources of light. This feature is ideal for capturing light trails, starry
  skies, fireworks, and even leaves floating on water.

  using Live Composite
* ## Computational photography
  
  Expressive photography driven by the latest technologies is in your hands with the press of the
  shutter button.

  Focus Stacking captures multiple shots at different focus points and merges them into a single
  image with greater depth of field. This allows you to achieve the desired depth without
  excessively narrowing the aperture. It's effective not only for macro photography but also for
  landscape shots.

  using Focus Stacking

The mission of the PACK Lab is to resolve real-world problems using technologies in perception,

Follow
* Long Beach, California
* [ Github][8]

# Perception, Actuation, Control, and Network (PACK) Lab

Welcome to the PACK Lab!

*The word “PACK” is the abbreviation of Perception, Actuation, Control, and Network. “PACK” are the
major components of the research conducted in this lab. Pack is also used in phrase “pack of
wolves”, which refers to the collective behavior of wolves.*

### The Grand Challenges

This world is facing many challenges, such as food security, traffic congestion, the aging
population, human resources shortage, and insufficient capability of production.

### Current Robot-Based Solutions

To solve these challenges, more and more robots are applied to assist with traditional
labor-intensive tasks. For example, drones are widely used to collect field data in precision
agriculture to replace conventional human data collection. There is no doubt that the robot-based
solution has many strengths, with low fault rate, high efficiency, great precision, and endurance.
Importantly, robots can replace humans to work in hazardous environments. However, robots are not
perfect so far - they still have limitations. For example, some robots can only carry out specific
objectives. And some robots need detailed path planning that may conflict with others if multiple
robots are in the same workspace. So, how do we break through these limitations?

### Robots as a PACK

One promising answer to this question is applying collaborative multi-agent systems. In nature,
collective animal behaviors are important to defend against prey, search for food, and migrate for
long distances. Inspired by the collective animal behaviors in nature, PACK lab is committed to
providing solutions to current grand challenges using a swarm of drones to monitor the field and
collect field data, a group of robot arms to perform complicated operations, and a collaboration of
autonomous vehicles to provide a safer driving experience. These collective intelligent agents
perform complex tasks beyond each individual’s capabilities.

### Location
* ECS-215A (space for modeling, simulation, and computation)
* EN3-108 (space for experiment)

California State University, Long Beach

### Resesarch Areas
* System and Control Theory
* Multi-Agent / Robot System
* Human-Robot / Swarm Interaction
* General Robotics

Importantly, robots can replace humans to work in hazardous environments. However, robots are not
perfect so far - they still have limitations. For example, some robots can only carry out specific
objectives. And some robots need detailed path planning that may conflict with others if multiple
robots are in the same workspace. So, how do we break through these limitations?

### Robots as a PACK

One promising answer to this question is applying collaborative multi-agent systems. In nature,
collective animal behaviors are important to defend against prey, search for food, and migrate for
long distances. Inspired by the collective animal behaviors in nature, PACK lab is committed to
providing solutions to current grand challenges using a swarm of drones to monitor the field and
collect field data, a group of robot arms to perform complicated operations, and a collaboration of
autonomous vehicles to provide a safer driving experience. These collective intelligent agents
perform complex tasks beyond each individual’s capabilities.

### Location
* ECS-215A (space for modeling, simulation, and computation)
* EN3-108 (space for experiment)

California State University, Long Beach

### Resesarch Areas
* System and Control Theory
* Multi-Agent / Robot System
* Human-Robot / Swarm Interaction
* General Robotics

# Pratik Ingle

[ Twitter ][6] [ GitHub ][7] [ Mastodon ][8] [ LinkedIn ][9] [ Email ][10] [ Blog ][11]

## Bio

I’m a BSMS candidate at the EECS department at IISERB. My research interests lie in the field of
swarm robotics and collective intelligence, with a particular focus on natural systems. I am
fascinated by the idea of building artificial collectives that possess the same scale and complexity
as those found in nature, and I am determined to explore this question from a variety of different
angles, including robotics, biology, and theory. Through my research, I hope to gain a deeper
understanding of the underlying principles that drive the behavior of these systems and to develop
new and innovative approaches to designing and building nature-inspired robot collectives. I hope
you find it interesting and informative, and I look forward to sharing more with you in the future.


## Research
* Robotics, Swarm Robotics
* Collective Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence
* Evolutionary Computation, RL algorithms


Research Interest

## Education

**Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal**
MP, India

Integrated BS-MS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science | August 2017 - Present (Expected
April 2023)


## Selected Projects

#### Publications

**Moving Depot: An Efficient Depot Motion Strategy for Multi-Robot Foraging.** Pratik Ingle, Ananya
Gandhi, and P.B. Sujit. 2022.(In preparation)[Preprint][12]

## FAQs
* What is remio, and who is it for?
  
  remio is an [AI-powered personal knowledge hub][87] designed to help users efficiently collect,
  organize, and utilize information.
  
  It transforms "messy info" into "clear insights" and is ideal for knowledge workers who handle
  large volumes of information, such as managers,professionals, [engineers][88], researchers, and
  [students][89].
* What are the core differences between remio and note-taking apps?
  
  remio is designed as your AI Second Brain & Assistant.
  
  It automatically captures web content and syncs local files into a private, secure [knowledge
  base][90]. And it's searchable by chat. You could just '[Ask remio][91]' to call back your digital
  memory or get powerful insights.
* How does remio help me build a "Second Brain"?
  
  The concept of a "[Second Brain][92]" is to offload information to an external system, freeing up
  your brain for thinking and creativity. remio helps you achieve this in the following ways:
  
  Acts as a digital memory: It automatically captures web pages you've browsed and your local files,
  effectively remembering everything for you.
  
  Intelligent Organization & Connection: It uses AI-suggested Collections to systematically organize
  information and helps you discover deep connections between pieces of knowledge.
  
  Efficient Knowledge Utilization: With the powerful AI feature "[Ask remio][93]", you can find and
  use the information you need in seconds, moving beyond simple storage.
* What are remio's core AI features?
  
  [AI Search][94]: The powerful "Ask remio" feature allows you to conversationally find answers
  across your entire knowledge base with precise source citations.
  
  AI Summary: Quickly generate concise summaries for long articles or videos. It works both in-app
  and in the browser extension.
  
  Smart Organization: AI automatically suggests relevant Collections to help you systematically
  organize information.
  
  [Upcoming Features][95]: These include "[Knowledge Blending][96]", which intelligently integrates
  new information into your existing note structure; and "[Smart Write][97]", which enhances writing
  efficiency with features like auto-completion and style matching.

## FAQs
* What is remio, and who is it for?
  
  remio is an [AI-powered personal knowledge hub][87] designed to help users efficiently collect,
  organize, and utilize information.
  
  It transforms "messy info" into "clear insights" and is ideal for knowledge workers who handle
  large volumes of information, such as managers,professionals, [engineers][88], researchers, and
  [students][89].
* What are the core differences between remio and note-taking apps?
  
  remio is designed as your AI Second Brain & Assistant.
  
  It automatically captures web content and syncs local files into a private, secure [knowledge
  base][90]. And it's searchable by chat. You could just '[Ask remio][91]' to call back your digital
  memory or get powerful insights.
* How does remio help me build a "Second Brain"?
  
  The concept of a "[Second Brain][92]" is to offload information to an external system, freeing up
  your brain for thinking and creativity. remio helps you achieve this in the following ways:
  
  Acts as a digital memory: It automatically captures web pages you've browsed and your local files,
  effectively remembering everything for you.
  
  Intelligent Organization & Connection: It uses AI-suggested Collections to systematically organize
  information and helps you discover deep connections between pieces of knowledge.
  
  Efficient Knowledge Utilization: With the powerful AI feature "[Ask remio][93]", you can find and
  use the information you need in seconds, moving beyond simple storage.
* What are remio's core AI features?
  
  [AI Search][94]: The powerful "Ask remio" feature allows you to conversationally find answers
  across your entire knowledge base with precise source citations.
  
  AI Summary: Quickly generate concise summaries for long articles or videos. It works both in-app
  and in the browser extension.
  
  Smart Organization: AI automatically suggests relevant Collections to help you systematically
  organize information.
  
  [Upcoming Features][95]: These include "[Knowledge Blending][96]", which intelligently integrates
  new information into your existing note structure; and "[Smart Write][97]", which enhances writing
  efficiency with features like auto-completion and style matching.

#### Robotics and Automation - Articles, Stories & Interviews

### [The Real Bottleneck in Agentic AI Is Not the Model, It Is the Handoff][17]

**Article from Dijam Panigrahi, Co-founder and COO of GridRaster Inc.**
Governance maturity across the industry still has room to grow. Broader enterprise research found
that only about one in five organizations have a mature governance model for autonomous AI agents, a
gap that mirrors what is showing up on the manufacturing floor specifically.

### [Maintaining Fibre Optic Performance in Industrial Robotics][18]

**Liam Taylor is European Business Manager, Fibre Optics | [MicroCare UK Ltd ][19]**
Even microscopic contamination on a fibre connector end face can interfere with light transmission.
In robotic applications where precision, repeatability and uptime are critical, small amounts of
contamination can contribute directly to performance issues.

### [Today’s Warehouse Robotics Landscape][20]

**Geoff Schreiber, Director, Product Management | [Toyota Automated Logistics][21]**
Robots are now more applicable for a wider range of warehouse tasks than ever before. Keep these
trends and considerations in mind to make the right investments, achieve effective implementations,
and realize the full business value of today’s robotic systems

### [Powering the next era of AI in manufacturing: Why it’s time to upgrade to the NVIDIA RTX PRO
### 4500 Blackwell Workstation Edition][22]

**Article from | [PNY][23]**
It delivers groundbreaking AI acceleration, neural rendering and the headroom needed for today’s
most demanding professional workflows powered by 5th Gen Tensor Cores, 4th Gen RT Cores and advanced
NVIDIA® CUDA® cores.

### [AGIBOT X2 Series Showcases Embodied AI at the World Cup, Marking a Historic Sports Companion
### Debut][24]

**Announcement from | [AGIBOT][25]**
This marks the first time an embodied AI humanoid robot has served as a full-scenario companion at a
World Cup, signaling embodied AI's expansion from industrial and laboratory settings into one of the
world's most celebrated sporting stages.

### [The Rise of Flexible Automation within the Supply Chain][26]

**Q&A with Celeste Chartier, Solution Consulting Manager | [Dematic][27]**
Supply chain automation will become more intelligent, connected, and adaptive. AI-driven software
will continue evolving from reactive monitoring toward predictive and prescriptive capabilities that
help operations rebalance workloads and automatically optimize performance.

### [What Bastian Solutions’ experience reveals about the future of AGV navigation][28]

**Case Study from | [BlueBotics][29]**
The question is no longer only whether an AGV can follow a route reliably, but whether its
navigation technology allows the robot to adapt as processes, layouts, and demands change.

kitchens, hotels, and living rooms, where robots can simulate everyday chores.

#### Robotics and Automation - Articles, Stories & Interviews

### [The Real Bottleneck in Agentic AI Is Not the Model, It Is the Handoff][17]

**Article from Dijam Panigrahi, Co-founder and COO of GridRaster Inc.**
Governance maturity across the industry still has room to grow. Broader enterprise research found
that only about one in five organizations have a mature governance model for autonomous AI agents, a
gap that mirrors what is showing up on the manufacturing floor specifically.

### [Maintaining Fibre Optic Performance in Industrial Robotics][18]

**Liam Taylor is European Business Manager, Fibre Optics | [MicroCare UK Ltd ][19]**
Even microscopic contamination on a fibre connector end face can interfere with light transmission.
In robotic applications where precision, repeatability and uptime are critical, small amounts of
contamination can contribute directly to performance issues.

### [Today’s Warehouse Robotics Landscape][20]

**Geoff Schreiber, Director, Product Management | [Toyota Automated Logistics][21]**
Robots are now more applicable for a wider range of warehouse tasks than ever before. Keep these
trends and considerations in mind to make the right investments, achieve effective implementations,
and realize the full business value of today’s robotic systems

### [Powering the next era of AI in manufacturing: Why it’s time to upgrade to the NVIDIA RTX PRO
### 4500 Blackwell Workstation Edition][22]

**Article from | [PNY][23]**
It delivers groundbreaking AI acceleration, neural rendering and the headroom needed for today’s
most demanding professional workflows powered by 5th Gen Tensor Cores, 4th Gen RT Cores and advanced
NVIDIA® CUDA® cores.

### [AGIBOT X2 Series Showcases Embodied AI at the World Cup, Marking a Historic Sports Companion
### Debut][24]

**Announcement from | [AGIBOT][25]**
This marks the first time an embodied AI humanoid robot has served as a full-scenario companion at a
World Cup, signaling embodied AI's expansion from industrial and laboratory settings into one of the
world's most celebrated sporting stages.

### [The Rise of Flexible Automation within the Supply Chain][26]

**Q&A with Celeste Chartier, Solution Consulting Manager | [Dematic][27]**
Supply chain automation will become more intelligent, connected, and adaptive. AI-driven software
will continue evolving from reactive monitoring toward predictive and prescriptive capabilities that
help operations rebalance workloads and automatically optimize performance.

### [What Bastian Solutions’ experience reveals about the future of AGV navigation][28]

**Case Study from | [BlueBotics][29]**
The question is no longer only whether an AGV can follow a route reliably, but whether its
navigation technology allows the robot to adapt as processes, layouts, and demands change.

kitchens, hotels, and living rooms, where robots can simulate everyday chores.

  ## [mimic robotics develops model for industrial robot training][33]
  
  by [Pieter Werner][34]
  by [Pieter Werner][35] 24 juli 2026
  
  Zurich-based mimic robotics has developed a video-action model designed to help industrial robots
  learn complex manipulation tasks from relatively small amounts of demonstration data. The model,
  called FLUX-mimic, was developed with Black Forest Labs and combines mimic robotics’ work in robot
  learning and dexterous manipulation with the architecture of Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 video
  model. The companies are testing the technology in manufacturing environments with Audi.

  ## [U.S. Air Force Adds $2.9 Million to Palladyne AI Robotics Programme][42]
  
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][43]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][44] 24 juli 2026
  
  The U.S. Air Force is continuing its investment in autonomous military robotics by adding $2.9
  million to an existing development contract with Palladyne AI. The additional funding brings the
  total value of the programme to more than $10.6 million. The contract supports the development of
  Palladyne IQ, an embodied artificial intelligence architecture designed to allow robots to learn
  physical tasks from human demonstrations and subsequently perform them autonomously.

  ## [Ontario Lawyer Suspended Six Months After ChatGPT-Generated Fake Cases][51]
  
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][52]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][53] 24 juli 2026
  
  An Ontario lawyer has been suspended from practising law for six months after she filed a court
  document containing fabricated case citations generated by ChatGPT, then compounded the error by
  repeatedly lying to a judge and to her regulator about what had happened. The July 16, 2026 ruling
  from the Law Society Tribunal, Law Society of Ontario v Lee, is one of the most detailed
  disciplinary decisions yet on lawyers’ use of generative AI, and a cautionary tale about how a
  technology mistake can spiral into a much bigger integrity problem.

  by [Pieter Werner][61]
  by [Pieter Werner][62] 23 juli 2026
  
  NEURA Robotics and RWTH Aachen University are developing a robotics training facility at the
  university’s Hightech Campus Melaten, with an opening planned by the end of 2026. The
  approximately 3,000-square-metre NEURA Gym RWTH Aachen will support robotics research, artificial
  intelligence training and the testing of robots for industrial applications. Around 20 university
  institutes are expected to participate in the facility.

  crewed attack and assault aircraft in contested battlefield environments. The aircraft, called
  Thunder, is a Group 5 unmanned tiltrotor intended to carry weapons, launched effects, electronic
  warfare systems and cargo. Anduril is developing the platform with Archer Aviation and other
  industry partners, with a first flight planned for 2027.

  by [Marco van der Hoeven][109]
  by [Marco van der Hoeven][110] 22 juli 2026
  
  UK robotics company Humanoid has raised $152 million in a Series A funding round that values the
  business at $1.35 billion after the investment. The financing brings the company’s total capital
  raised to $270 million. The round was led by Prime Movers Lab, with participation from Schaeffler,
  Bosch, Fubon Financial Holding Venture Capital and Aglaé Ventures. Humanoid plans to use the
  proceeds to develop its next-generation robotics platform, expand commercial deployments and
  increase investment in its artificial intelligence and software systems.

# Ruflo — Multi-Agent AI Orchestration Platform

Deploy intelligent AI swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, share memory across agents, and build
enterprise-grade AI systems with Ruflo.

[Get Started ][12][ View GitHub][13][ Read Docs][14][Explore Features][15]
Multi-Agent SwarmsShared MemoryMCP ReadyEnterprise SecurityLocal + DistributedOpen Source
swarm.execute()
7 agents · 12 edges · live
What is Ruflo

## An AI orchestration platform built for swarm intelligence

Ruflo coordinates multiple specialized AI agents working together on complex tasks. Unlike
traditional tools relying on a single agent, Ruflo enables collaborative swarms with shared memory,
autonomous coordination, federated communication and intelligent routing.

Multi-agent AI

Specialized roles collaborate in parallel

Shared memory

Versioned context across sessions

AI orchestration

Smart routing, consensus, delegation

MCP-native

Plug into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex

Why Ruflo

## Single agents hit a ceiling. Swarms scale past it.

Without Ruflo

### Single-agent ceiling
* Single AI agent
* Limited context
* No shared memory
* Repeated prompts
* Higher token costs
* Poor coordination

With Ruflo

### Coordinated swarm intelligence
* Multiple specialized agents
* Shared knowledge
* Autonomous workflows
* Better decisions
* Faster execution
* Lower operational cost

Features

## Everything you need for production AI orchestration

From swarm topologies to federated memory, Ruflo gives you the primitives to ship reliable
multi-agent systems.

### Multi-Agent Swarms

Coordinate dozens or hundreds of specialized AI agents on a single task.

### Shared Memory Engine

Persistent, versioned context every agent can read and write.

### Federated Communication

Secure agent-to-agent messaging across machines and clusters.

### MCP Integration

Native Model Context Protocol support across Claude, Cursor, Codex.

### Autonomous Task Routing

Route work to the best agent based on role, load and skill.

### Distributed Intelligence

Scale workflows across teams, machines and edge nodes.

### Enterprise Security

Trust boundaries, signed messages, RBAC and audit logs.

### Workflow Automation

Build autonomous pipelines with retries, branching and consensus.

### Self-Learning Loops

Memory + feedback continuously improves agent behavior.

[See all features ][16]
Quick start

## Install Ruflo in seconds

A single CLI bootstraps Ruflo, registers it as an MCP server, and connects it to Claude Code, Cursor
or any compatible client.

[Read the docs][17][MCP setup][18]

$ npm install -g ruflo
$ ruflo init
✔ Ruflo initialized
✔ MCP server registered

$ ruflo swarm spawn --task "refactor auth"
→ planner.online
→ coder.online   reviewer.online
→ tester.online
✔ swarm ready · 4 agents · memory: shared

## Build the next layer of AI infrastructure

Ruflo is open source and production-ready. Deploy your first swarm today.

──┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬──
  │# www.Swarm-Robotics.org                                                                      │  
──┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──
  │Swarm robotics is  the study of how large  number of relatively simple physically embodied    │  
  │agents can be designed such that a desired collective behavior emerges from the local         │  
  │interactions among agents and between the agents and the environment. It is a novel approach  │  
  │to the coordination of large numbers of robots. It is inspired from the observation of social │  
  │insects ---ants, termites, wasps and bees--- which stand as fascinating examples of how a     │  
  │large number of simple [individuals][1] can interact to create collectively intelligent       │  
  │systems. Social insects are known to coordinate their actions to accomplish tasks that are    │  
  │beyond the capabilities of a single individual: termites build large and complex mounds, army │  
  │ants organize impressive foraging raids, ants can collectively carry large preys. Such        │  
  │coordination capabilities are still beyond the reach of current multi-robot systems.          │  
  │                                                                                              │  
  │This site aims to compile swarm-robotics related announcements, resources and links. Please   │  
  │send such information to Erol Sahin to be put online.                                         │  
──┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──
  │## Announcements                                                                              │  
  │* [SAB'06 Swarm Robotics Workshop!][2] Submission deadline: July 1, 2006.                     │  
  │* Elektrik: Special Issue on Swarm Robotics! Submission deadline: August 31, 2006             │  
  │* ANTS 2006: Sept 4-7, 2006 @ Brussels, Belgium. Title and abstract deadline: March 12, 2006  │  
  │* Special Issue of Multi-Agent and Grid Systems - An International Journal: Special Issue on  │  
  │  Nature-Inspired Systems for Parallel, Asynchronous and Decentralised Environments. Paper    │  
  │  submission deadline: May 6, 2006                                                            │  
  │* DISTRIBUTED INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS - Collective Intelligence and its Applications, IEEE        │  
  │  workshop on distributed intelligent systems as collective robotics, agent-based             │  
  │  manufacturing and agent-based coalition formation and their applications. June 15-16, 2006 @│  
  │  Prague, Czech Republic. Submission deadline: February 13, 2006.                             │  
  │* IEEE Swarm Intelligence Symposium: May 12-14 2006 @ Indianapolis, USA. Submission deadline: │  
  │  Jan 21, 2006.                                                                               │  
──┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──
  │## Resources                                                                                  │  
  │* WebBibTex database for swarm robotics literature. In this database, swarm robotics related  │  
  │  literature is being compiled. You can browse through the literature, or by creating a user  │  
  │  for yourself insert new entries to the database. If you already have a Bibtex file, we can  │  
  │  also upload it directly to the database.                                                    │  
  │* [SAB'04 Swarm Robotics Workshop][3]. The workshop web page also contains the presentations  │  
  │  made at the workshop.                                                                       │  
  │* [Autonomous Robots: Special Issue on Swarm Robotics][4], published on September 2004. The   │  
  │  CfP and the table of contents of this issue are available.                                  │  
  │                                                                                              │  
──┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──
  │## Links                                                                                      │  
  │* Swarmrobot.org: An open source micro-robotic project.                                       │

  │* CORO at Caltech                                                                             │  
  │* [Old page][5]                                                                               │  
  │* [Swarm Robotics Literature][6]

[FireAnt UGV 3/4 view with EO/IR payload]
AttritableModular payloadsSwarm autonomy
Learn More

Field-proven autonomy stack enabling swarm control and human teaming.

Web appATAK appTriple redundant comms

Modular, attritable, autonomous UGV swarms integrating into human formations now.

### Swarm Autonomy
* Coordinated behaviors across mixed teams and missions.
* Real-time tasking, data sharing, and kill chain acceleration.
* Seamless fit with maneuver C2 structures.

### Built for Combat
* Proven against dust, heat, vibration, and shock.
* IP6 sealed for water and dust resistance.
* Field-hardened for the harshest combat environments.

* Rapid payload swaps with extensive interoperability.
* Plug-and-play integration with allied systems.
* Supports ISR, EW, logistics, and direct-action modules.

### Military-grade swarm logic. Combat-ready hardware.

Now fielding UGV swarms to maneuver formations.

# Swarm Robots — Structural Reference

Independent, jurisdiction-neutral, non-advisory reference.

## Identity

This domain defines swarm robots as coordinated multi-agent robotic systems where collective
behavior emerges from decentralized interaction among multiple robots. The reference stabilizes
terminology and system boundaries used in discussions of swarm robotics architectures.

This site does not provide engineering guidance, operational instructions, regulatory
interpretation, or deployment recommendations.

## Scope Boundary

### Included
* Multi-robot coordination systems
* Decentralized collective behavior
* Distributed task allocation among robots
* Swarm communication and signaling models
* Conceptual architecture of swarm systems

### Excluded
* Specific robotics platforms or vendors
* Operational deployment guidance
* Engineering design instructions
* Algorithm implementation or performance claims

## System Definition

Swarm robots are defined as distributed multi-agent systems in which no single unit governs the
system and coordination emerges through local interaction mechanisms.

### System Boundaries
* No centralized control authority governing all agents
* System behavior emerges from local interactions between agents
* Each unit operates with partial system knowledge
* System identity is defined by collective behavior rather than individual capability

### Boundary Conditions
* Swarm systems exclude centrally controlled multi-robot systems
* Swarm systems exclude single-robot systems with modular extensions
* Swarm systems exclude coordinated systems requiring full global state awareness

## Reference Model

### Layer 1 — Local Agent Behavior

Individual robots operate using local sensing and rule-based behavior without centralized control.

### Layer 2 — Swarm Interaction

Robots exchange signals or environmental cues that allow collective coordination and emergent system
behavior.

### Layer 3 — Collective System Outcome

Through repeated local interactions, swarm-level structures and task outcomes emerge without central
orchestration.

**Interpretation boundary:** This model describes structural concepts only and does not define
engineering implementations.

## Method & Sources

Method discipline is defined in [/method/][1]. Institutional and documentary anchors are listed in
[/sources/][2].

## Status & Maintenance

Status: Public structural reference, versioned through changelog control.

Change discipline: material changes only (definition shifts, structural corrections, institutional
updates). Minor editorial adjustments are not logged. See [/changelog/][3].

Contact (corrections or material updates): contact[at]swarmrobots.com

**Independent definitional reference.** No advisory, legal, financial, compliance, or consulting
services.

## Swarm Technology is revolutionizing AI by Mapping the Solidarity Cell Architecture to Agentic
## Processing

In the ever-evolving landscape of artificial intelligence, two groundbreaking concepts converge to
create a new paradigm in distributed computing and autonomous systems. The solidarity cell
architecture, known for its innovative approach to parallel processing, is finding growing synergy
with agentic processing. This fusion promises to unlock new AI potentials, offering unprecedented
scalability, flexibility, and resilience.

## The Power of Autonomy

At the heart of both solidarity cell architecture and agentic processing lies the concept of
[autonomous agents][23]. Solidarity cells are independent processors proactively seeking tasks from
a shared pool, operating with remarkable self-sufficiency. Moreover, agentic processing revolves
around AI agents capable of making decisions and executing tasks without constant human oversight.
Imagine a system where AI agents, inspired by solidarity cells, respond to assigned tasks and
actively seek work, optimizing system resources and adapting to changing priorities in real-time.

## Distributed Intelligence: A New Frontier

Solidarity cells spread processing tasks across specialized cells, while agentic processing divides
complex workflows among purpose-built AI agents. This distributed approach enhances processing power
and introduces a level of robustness previously unseen in traditional centralized systems.

Combining these methodologies allows us to envision an AI ecosystem where specialized agents, like
solidarity cells, form a dynamic network of distributed intelligence. Each agent could handle
specific tasks while contributing to a larger, more complex objective.

We exhibited our second generation swarm-intelligent robots at

[**Internet of Things World 2018**][24]

Santa Clara, California, May 14-17, 2018

We exhibited our cloud-connected swarm-intelligent robots at:

[**IoT**][25][** Tech Expo North America 2017**][26]

Santa Clara, California, November 29-30, 2017

We exhibited our first-generation swarm-intelligent robots at:

[**International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2017**][27]

Vancouver, Canada, September 24–28, 2017

We exhibited our initial proof-of-concept prototype at:

[**Internet of Things World 2017**][28]

Santa Clara, California, May 16-18, 2017

The **Solidarity Cell Architecture** enables dynamic-scalable heterogeneous distributed computing,
artificial swarm intelligence, and intent-based automation at scale with limitless scalability and
endless resiliency.

Swarm Technology is a startup company with prototypes demonstrating collective intelligence and
forward-looking intellectual property dating back to January 25, 2013.

This video — from 2015 — is a proof-of-concept demonstrating collective intelligence. Nowadays, the
company has perfected the robots’ reaction time and performance. However, we have chosen to showcase
the Five Principles of Swarm Intelligence **video** due to its avant-garde technology from a decade
ago.

# Artificial Intelligence

Applications:

[**Open AI’s **][29][**Artificial**][30][** General Intelligence**][31]

[**Intent-Based Networking**][32]

# Swarm Robotics

Applications:

[**Swarm Intelligence in Robotics**][33]

[**Autonomous Vehicles** ][34]

# Edge Computing

Applications:

[**Swarm Intelligence in IoT**][35]

[**Agen-Based Processing**][36]

## Swarm Technology is revolutionizing AI by Mapping the Solidarity Cell Architecture to Agentic
## Processing

In the ever-evolving landscape of artificial intelligence, two groundbreaking concepts converge to
create a new paradigm in distributed computing and autonomous systems. The solidarity cell
architecture, known for its innovative approach to parallel processing, is finding growing synergy
with agentic processing. This fusion promises to unlock new AI potentials, offering unprecedented
scalability, flexibility, and resilience.

## The Power of Autonomy

At the heart of both solidarity cell architecture and agentic processing lies the concept of
[autonomous agents][23]. Solidarity cells are independent processors proactively seeking tasks from
a shared pool, operating with remarkable self-sufficiency. Moreover, agentic processing revolves
around AI agents capable of making decisions and executing tasks without constant human oversight.
Imagine a system where AI agents, inspired by solidarity cells, respond to assigned tasks and
actively seek work, optimizing system resources and adapting to changing priorities in real-time.

## Distributed Intelligence: A New Frontier

Solidarity cells spread processing tasks across specialized cells, while agentic processing divides
complex workflows among purpose-built AI agents. This distributed approach enhances processing power
and introduces a level of robustness previously unseen in traditional centralized systems.

Combining these methodologies allows us to envision an AI ecosystem where specialized agents, like
solidarity cells, form a dynamic network of distributed intelligence. Each agent could handle
specific tasks while contributing to a larger, more complex objective.

We exhibited our second generation swarm-intelligent robots at

[**Internet of Things World 2018**][24]

Santa Clara, California, May 14-17, 2018

We exhibited our cloud-connected swarm-intelligent robots at:

[**IoT**][25][** Tech Expo North America 2017**][26]

Santa Clara, California, November 29-30, 2017

We exhibited our first-generation swarm-intelligent robots at:

[**International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2017**][27]

Vancouver, Canada, September 24–28, 2017

We exhibited our initial proof-of-concept prototype at:

[**Internet of Things World 2017**][28]

Santa Clara, California, May 16-18, 2017

The **Solidarity Cell Architecture** enables dynamic-scalable heterogeneous distributed computing,
artificial swarm intelligence, and intent-based automation at scale with limitless scalability and
endless resiliency.

Swarm Technology is a startup company with prototypes demonstrating collective intelligence and
forward-looking intellectual property dating back to January 25, 2013.

This video — from 2015 — is a proof-of-concept demonstrating collective intelligence. Nowadays, the
company has perfected the robots’ reaction time and performance. However, we have chosen to showcase
the Five Principles of Swarm Intelligence **video** due to its avant-garde technology from a decade
ago.

[**Intent-Based Networking**][32]

Applications:

[**Swarm Intelligence in Robotics**][33]

[**Autonomous Vehicles** ][34]

# Edge Computing

Applications:

[**Swarm Intelligence in IoT**][35]

[**Agen-Based Processing**][36]

Tribe is a next-generation group chat platform where you can go deep on your interests with
fascinating people.

### What Tribe Members Are Saying

“Such a refreshing app. Clean, simple, and easy to use without all the noise you get elsewhere.

It really feels like a genuine space to connect with people and find your tribe. Warm welcoming and
thoughtfully designed.”

`— Anjita2`

“Community is at the core of human connection, and Tribe is doing a great job helping you find and
connect with people who share your interests. I’ve found like-minded parents, fitness enthusiasts,
and book lovers from around the world.

If you want to feel connected to a gathering spread across the world or around your neighborhood,
Tribe is the app for that.”

`— Itirka`

“The app is extremely easy to use. I love that there are no ads. Built-in trivia if your community
does that kind of thing and absolutely brings everyone closer together.

I truly can’t think of anything negative. Absolutely worth a try!”

Do you have passions and interests you'd love to discuss with others? Discover group chats on Tribe
and find folks who love the same things you do!

# Find your tribe

Tribe is a next-generation group chat platform where you can go deep on your interests with
fascinating people.

[ [Download for Mac] ][28] [ [Download on the Mac App Store] ][29] [ [Launch on Web] ][30] [
[Download on the App Store] ][31] [ [Get it on Google Play] ][32]
[QR code with text 'Scan the QR to get Tribe on your phone' and icons for downloading on Apple App
Store and Google Play.]

### What Tribe Members Are Saying

“Such a refreshing app. Clean, simple, and easy to use without all the noise you get elsewhere.

It really feels like a genuine space to connect with people and find your tribe. Warm welcoming and
thoughtfully designed.”

`— Anjita2`

“Community is at the core of human connection, and Tribe is doing a great job helping you find and
connect with people who share your interests. I’ve found like-minded parents, fitness enthusiasts,
and book lovers from around the world.

If you want to feel connected to a gathering spread across the world or around your neighborhood,
Tribe is the app for that.”

`— Itirka`

“The app is extremely easy to use. I love that there are no ads. Built-in trivia if your community
does that kind of thing and absolutely brings everyone closer together.

I truly can’t think of anything negative. Absolutely worth a try!”

`— ReaperOfS0uls`

## Easily discover group chats

Do you have passions and interests you'd love to discuss with others? Discover group chats on Tribe
and find folks who love the same things you do!

[Grid with icons and categories like Geopolitics, Foodies, Parenting, Travel, Book Club, Fitness,
Music Lovers, Movies and Shows, Investments, Sports, Pets, Bible Study, and "Much more.." on a light
background.]

## Know who you are chatting with.

Build real connection and trust with other members of a group chat. Tribe is 'real name' only and
members are encouraged to post their social profiles and details about themselves. Build IRL
friendships and contacts while chatting on your phone!

Key answers for enterprise cleaning automation.

### Which facilities benefit from cleaning robots?

Best for large, high-traffic environments needing consistent, repeatable cleaning—warehouses,
airports, healthcare, and corporate campuses.

### What is the deployment workflow?

We assess your site, run a pilot, review ROI, plan rollout, and provide ongoing support for stable
operations.

### What post-installation support is provided?

Includes local technician service, preventive maintenance, escalation, and direct support from our
regional center.

### Can robots work with existing teams?

Yes. Robots handle repetitive tasks, allowing staff to focus on specialized cleaning.

### Are financing options available?

Choose direct purchase or flexible third-party financing, with options for maintenance bundling.
